title: Initial sorting terms
statement: On three Boolean coordinates, take the list of three conjunction terms with literal lists $[(0,+1),(2,+1),(1,+1)]$, $[(0,+1),(2,-1)]$, and $[(0,-1),(1,+1),(2,+1)]$, where each pair records a coordinate and its required sign. Each term has distinct coordinate indices.
caveat: The pair-term constructor's precise meaning is not supplied; the listed coordinates and signs follow its apparent argument convention.
